claim_validity_order.name: claim_validity_order
claim_validity_order.value: "claim"."valid_until" IS NULL OR "claim"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "claim"."valid_from" <= "claim"."valid_until"

claim_evidence_has_origin.name: claim_evidence_has_origin
claim_evidence_has_origin.value: "claim_evidence"."snapshot_id" IS NOT NULL OR "claim_evidence"."submission_id" IS NOT NULL OR "claim_evidence"."extraction_method" IN ('manual', 'fixture')

claim_evidence_llm_metadata.name: claim_evidence_llm_metadata
claim_evidence_llm_metadata.value: "claim_evidence"."extraction_method" <> 'llm' OR ("claim_evidence"."llm_model" IS NOT NULL AND "claim_evidence"."prompt_version" IS NOT NULL AND "claim_evidence"."evidence_quote" IS NOT NULL)

comp_report_outcome_needs_application.name: comp_report_outcome_needs_application
comp_report_outcome_needs_application.value: "comp_report"."applied" OR ("comp_report"."accepted" IS NULL AND "comp_report"."furthest_stage" IS NULL)

membership_estimate_shape.name: membership_estimate_shape
membership_estimate_shape.value: ("membership_estimate"."kind" = 'exact' AND "membership_estimate"."count" IS NOT NULL) OR ("membership_estimate"."kind" = 'range' AND ("membership_estimate"."min" IS NOT NULL OR "membership_estimate"."max" IS NOT NULL))
